title: Bihar Police Seize $13,000 Worth of Contraband at Godda Border Crossing
summary: On [date], Bihar police intercepted two smugglers from Bihar who were transporting contraband worth approximately $13,000 to Jharkhand. The smugglers were arrested during a vehicle checking operation. The seized contraband included cannabis valued at ₹50,000. Police claimed that the smugglers had been using this route to transport illicit goods into Jharkhand.
summary_points: Bihar police intercepted two smugglers from Bihar on [date].
The smugglers were transporting contraband worth approximately $13,000 to Jharkhand.
Cannabis valued at ₹50,000 was seized during the operation.
Police claimed that the smugglers had been using this route to transport illicit goods into Jharkhand.
title_hi: बिहार पुलिस ने गोड्डा सीमा पर $13,000 की अवैध वस्तुओं को जब्त किया।
summary_hi: गोड्डा में बिहार से झारखंड ले जाने वाले दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया, जिसमें $13,000 की अवैध वस्तुओं को जब्त किया गया।
summary_points_hi: बिहार से झारखंड ले जाने वाले दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया।
अवैध वस्तुओं की मूल्य लगभग ₹50,000 है।
पुलिस ने यह बात बताई कि ये तस्कर अवैध वस्तुओं को झारखंड में ले जाने का रास्ता बनाते थे।
